all_weather.label: All Weather
all_weather.thesis: Balanced deployment across premium capture, long volatility, and directional books.

theta_harvest.label: Theta Harvest
theta_harvest.thesis: Lean into short premium when tape is orderly and realized volatility stays contained.

bull_trend.label: Bull Trend
bull_trend.thesis: Favor bullish spreads when momentum is positive and panic risk is low.

bear_trend.label: Bear Trend
bear_trend.thesis: Favor bearish spreads and protection when downside momentum builds.

long_vol_breakout.label: Long Vol Breakout
long_vol_breakout.thesis: Prefer convexity and breakout trades when volatility is rising fast.

panic_hedge.label: Panic Hedge
panic_hedge.thesis: Shrink short premium, keep convexity on, and let defense dominate in panic regimes.

mean_reversion.label: Mean Reversion
mean_reversion.thesis: Favor range capture and measured directional fades in choppy, non-trending tapes.

trend_acceleration.label: Trend Acceleration
trend_acceleration.thesis: Lean harder into directional books when trend conviction is high and breadth is supportive.

defensive_carry.label: Defensive Carry
defensive_carry.thesis: Harvest measured theta while keeping hedges and bearish convexity ready in fragile tapes.

volatility_rotation.label: Volatility Rotation
volatility_rotation.thesis: Rotate toward convexity and faster directional books as volatility regimes transition.

crash_reversal.label: Crash Reversal
crash_reversal.thesis: Keep convexity on but allow selective bullish rebound exposure when panic becomes one-sided.

massive_overview.note: Framework emphasizes walk-forward predictive quality, state-conditioned strategy routing, and delay-aware execution realism. It is still a deployment filter rather than an exact broker-fill simulator.

institutional_robustness.note: Institutional robustness emphasizes valid-window breadth, stability, execution realism, and evidence depth. It is a deployment filter, not a profit guarantee.
